## Checklist
<!-- Mark conditional items N/A with a reason; do not claim global app compliance from adoption. -->
- [ ] Standards and requested acceptance criteria reviewed separately
- [ ] Applicable checks executed; no weakened thresholds, skipped tests, or hidden baseline failures
- [ ] Changed behavior tested; bugs have a failing regression before the fix
- [ ] Private data authorized on the server; external inputs validated
- [ ] UI accessibility checked automatically and manually where applicable
- [ ] Indexable pages: appropriate metadata/canonical/sitemap/structured data; hreflang only with i18n
- [ ] Selected i18n: catalogs, formatting, and navigation updated
- [ ] Migrations/integrations/config changes are within the approved scope
- [ ] Instructions, project contract, specs, significant ADRs, and relevant env names updated
- [ ] Existing work preserved; no secrets/PII or unauthorized commits/deployments
